# skycloak_realm_groups (Data Source)

Top-level groups in a realm.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "skycloak_realm_groups" "all" {
  cluster_id = skycloak_cluster.production.id
  realm_name = skycloak_realm.app.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID.
- `realm_name` (String) Realm name.

### Read-Only

- `groups` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--groups))

<a id="nestedatt--groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `groups`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Group ID.
- `name` (String) Group name.
- `path` (String) Canonical group path.
